reviews.text: This hospital saved my dog, Bruno, from bladder stones! His surgery went very well, and he’s now happy, active, and feeling like himself again. ❤️ The staff is caring, affordable, and truly willing to help pet owners when they need it most. A huge thank-you to Dr. Basaran and Dr. K for taking such great care of my boy. I’m incredibly grateful and highly recommend this hospital to anyone looking for compassionate, affordable veterinary care!

Do not go here: there's a reason they don't have a waitlist and everywhere else does! When my cat wasn't improving and I went to the veterinary ER, they literally didn't even recognize the drug this office prescribed. This was years back but my friend literally just had their own awful experience here and it reminded me to leave a review and warn people.
Fiona was really nice and helpful. It’s refreshing to see someone that really cares about animals and with great customer service!

I have a large Belgian Shepherd that tore his foot and required stitches. He’s reactive and no other Veterinarian would even deal with him without suggesting sedating him every visit. He took great care of my dog and was able to handle him without hurting or sedating him. I would trust them with every check up or surgery and continue to bring him there for future care. If your dog is difficult at the vet, Dr. Konstantinov is very understanding and makes sure your dog receives the proper care without any unnecessary charges.

I bring my cats here, yesterday I brought my cat Pepper in and always have a good experience. The woman at the front desk was nice and answered my questions and Dr. K was also very nice. I like coming here and feel the prices are very reasonable compared to other places that charge way more! The staff is nice and friendly and most importantly they make me feel like my cat(s) are in great hands!

I also had a great experience 2 years ago. All my cats (4) were sneezing and had runny eyes. I was told I just had to bring one of them in instead of all 4, which saved me from a headache/struggle. I was given antibiotics for all 4 cats and was in awe of how low the price was for the Medication.

Thank you Logan Square Animal Hospital!
From Alexis, Binky, Tinky, Pepper and Pickles :)
I've been taking my cats and dogs here for over 20 years and I love them!  They are reasonable and compassionate and I've always appreciated that!

Would NEVER recommend this place even for simple inoculations, Dr. Bazzran is good but is never there anymore it seems unfortunately. Stay FAR away from Dr. Constantin he does not care about your pet only your money and is more like a used car salesman than a veterinarian also with abysmal bed side manner. 0/5

The entire annual physical for my cat lasted less than 2 minutes, seemed extremely surface level, and the only question asked about my cat’s lifestyle was if she is an indoor or outdoor cat. I left very disappointed that my cat didn’t get the care and attention she deserved.

I was hopeful to find a good vet in the neighborhood, and rarely leave negative reviews, but I would advise against going here for your beloved pet.
so diificult doing anything at this place

I called to make appointment and they had 3 appointments today, so i chose the early one for my dog Allergies shot. I live far from this place. when i got to the clinic i was told they dont have the shots anymore they will have them again on Tuesday. When i ask why didnt they contact me to cancel the appointment all i got was sorry. if we dont call and not show up they will punish us, but its okay for them to have someone drive all the way and only get SORRY
Excellent care, experienced doctors, reasonable prices, not corporate. Very caring for the animal's well being.

I saw two different vets here and both had just horrible bedside manner. One of them laughed at my questions, they both gave us necessary medicine (my current vet told me) which gave my cat diarrhea for no good reason. The office itself is old and gross. The poor support staff are clearly extremely annoyed and frustrated with the vets that boss then around rudely, and then the support staff is expected to pick up the pieces.

Also, one time when I was waiting in the lobby, I heard the support staff get a call about after surgery care, and the vet said to tell the caller “close the account, we don’t do post op care” are you joking???

Dr. B tried to help one of my senior cats, Pablo, after being diagnosed with a canceres tumor on his leg. Even with the odds against him, he was more than willing to help me try to give him a little bit more time with us. After everything was going south for him, Dr. B was very compassionate and understanding helping me with the grieving.
He truly loves what he does and is great with all his animals.

I’m am so frustrated with this hospital!!
I brought my new puppy in for her vaccination and because she had an ear infection. The first appointment went great, and I paid $214. As I was checking out, I knew I needed to schedule her 3-week follow-up. The receptionist told me, “Your next visit will be at no cost,” which I thought was perfect.

Yesterday, I called to schedule her 3-week second dose. The person I spoke with said they could see her at 11:15. When I arrived, they said there was no appointment scheduled. I instantly panicked because I live EXTREMELY far, I work a lot, and this was one of my only days off for a week and a half. She also needs her shots for daycare. The doctor agreed to see her, but it wasn’t until after the medication was given that I found out it wasn’t just two doses—they want her to come back every 3 weeks until she’s 5 months old. I have never had to do that with my other puppies.

As I was leaving the office, the receptionist said, “Your total is $180.” That’s another $200, and I had been told the second visit would be free. She went to get what I assume was the office manager, who then explained that the office visit was free, not the treatment. At this point, I was upset.

This office plays on wording, causes confusion, and is not fully transparent. Because I work in the medical field, I understand that treatment costs are my responsibility, but to build a good rapport with your clients, transparency is important. Instead, I felt completely blindsided at the end of the visit. I paid, but I will never return to this office.

The doctor is nice, but this workplace is in serious need of improvement.

The whole staff is meaningful, patient, understanding, and kind, and they have your pets' best interest at heart, and it shows in the work that they do. My fur baby (dog) is always excited to go there, which is hilarious! She will continue to be a patient here!
The doctors and staff at Logan Square Animal Hospital are the best.

I recently moved to the area and decided to transfer my Great Dane’s care from a Lakeview clinic to Logan Square Animal Hospital since it was close to home and I’d heard some positive things. Unfortunately, my experience left me disappointed.

Before the appointment, I emailed my dog’s records and asked about protocols for large, anxious dogs, my dog is 155 lbs and has historically needed oral sedation for vaccinations to avoid dangerous thrashing or injury. Despite sending multiple follow-ups, I never received a single response. That lack of communication was already concerning, but I kept the appointment when my dog developed signs of an ear infection.

Upon arrival, the front desk staff were indifferent at best- unfriendly enough that I genuinely felt like checking in was bothering them. After waiting about 20 minutes with no updates, I was finally seen by Dr. Konstantinov and a vet tech. In that short visit, the doctor dismissed my concerns, commenting that my dog “should be more confident” for his size, and repeatedly pushed for vaccinations despite my prior explanations (which they had ignored) that he needs advance planning. He even suggested restraining my dog with a metal device in the back or that I personally “just hold him down”, neither of which is safe or humane. When I advocated for my dog, he laughed, then warned me that the oral sedative prescribed by my former vet “could kill him.”

The only positive part of the visit was a younger staff member, kind, respectful, and exactly what you hope to encounter in an animal care setting. Unfortunately, that was the exception.

The clinic itself feels outdated, but the real concern here is the dismissive communication, lack of professionalism, and questionable handling recommendations for anxious large-breed dogs. Ultimately, I cannot recommend Logan Square Animal Hospital if you’re looking for a vet team that genuinely listens and prioritizes animal well-being.
Dr. Basran is the best! Idk where we will go if he retires.
Grate service unfortunately parking sucks
Good service handle our new dog with care and understanding. As he has some issues.  Professional staff.

So have discovered Logan Square due to my foster's from a local shelter. I cannot say enough about Dr.Besan! I feel we speak same language! I have been non stop since '97 caring for rescue/foster/rehabilitation and puppy mill socialization. Used to be breed specific but now take the old and moldy/hospice cases both dogs and cats.

He is an amazingly kind vet and human!!! The staff is so nice and my issue is I am in Andersonville so used to being close to my vets but seriously thinking of bringing my other former medical fosters  now hospice from different shelter now  to him!

The city has made parking a challenge but he is sooo worth it!!! I used to have a vet like him at Uptown Animal but once retired lost that compassion and understanding. They are few and far between but he is that vet!!! So nice and kowledgeable/sensible with my old animals condition doesn't give the emergency vet hard sell of extras like excessive labs or other treatments!

So many milking dollars but he is just respectful and straight on where your at and what to reasonably expect insofar as your animals care. He is a hidden gem! If you need a vet who you want to tell u straight talk and not gouging u to rack up dollars go see him because he is awesome!!!

Back in Nov. 2021 I had a bad experience. Took my Maltese there as he had a lump near his lymph nodes. And I was concerned it was lymphoma, they did some diagnostic test and talked me into taking out some of his teeth in case the lump was from an infection. Cost me 700$, they gave antibiotics took his teeth out, and gave some pain meds.
Fast forward a week later they tell me the test couldn’t find cancer cells, and I told them I didn’t believe that was the case as the antibiotics didnt result in anything.

They told me to come back in and that they’d redo the cancer diagnostic.

Another week or so passes and they call confirming Lymphoma.

My dog’s condition was deteriorating fast and I’d just spend over 700$ all for naught.

After that I decided to euthanize him at CACC because he was at the end stages where they just pee and defecate in one spot and are pretty immobile throughout the day.

(If you are gonna euthanize a pet , I would recommend another place other than CACC so you can actually be there for your pet during their final moments but this is off topic from Logan Square Animal Hospital)

I had another bad run in with this hospital when I adopted a cat from Paws a few years later in 2023 because I found blood in her stool. I never heard my cat make the noises that came out of her mouth undergoing treatment at Logan Square Animal Hospital. She was uncharacteristically aggressive with the vet and vet tech and they took her into the back to do some procedures to scan her G. I. Cost about 500$ and they said the item she ingested may naturally pass and to follow up in 24-48 hours if blood remained in the stool. While she was in the back undergoing her procedures she bit the vets and defecated all over herself. I never brought her back after that.

Can’t really justify that amount of stress for her so since then I’ve  be looking elsewhere for pet care.

Pretty pricey place and I feel as though I’ve been upsold on a lot of unnecessary things over the years with my other visits here prior to 2021.

They have treated all of our pets for years. Very knowledgeable and caring if a bit more nonsense. They did a great job with our cat’s surgery for less than half the price that another animal hospital quoted.

I've gotten my cat fixed and chipped here and it's been a positive experience after three visits. Staff is friendly and have answered any questions. Seem to handle my cat with care. Have also been upfront about all costs.

Updated: decided to move on from the animal hospital. Went to another vet and found out my cat had a significant heart murmur, a bit frustrated this was not caught in 3 visits with the one cat but was noticed within 5 min at another vet. Sometimes felt challenging to get my concerns across with the vet, the communication can be a bit weak at times.
Great veterinary clinic great people is my pet clinic
They were nice and reasonable with good price and did a good job.

Do you love your pet? Then don’t take them here. Your pet is an “it”, a “thing” they can make money off of. Had my pet cremated here and was never notified, I had to call myself three weeks later to inquire. Very meager apologies and no explanation (not that there is a good explanation for carelessness). I took my pets here for years and years, even through the decline with the terrible staff because admittedly Dr. Basran is amazing. But this was my final straw. There are nearby places with staff who use better word choice and show genuine concern for your pets and they cost the same- do a quick Google search and take them there.

Been client for 8 years, but moved my cat to different emergency clinic. Do not ever administer rabies booster for or at sick animal. This caused cancer. 80.dollars profit for them , but huge vet bills to save your pet afterneeds cleaner rooms and modernized system to max entend. The selling of rabies vaccine, avoid it. Pet needs one per Life time.

These guys saved my cat!!
My cat had a terrible accident, she jumped from our balcony and landed on the fence. We were lucky and the animal hospital got her in the operation room immediately. They did a great job treating her and patching her back. She is now in great shape and running around like she used to. I am extremely thankful for their professional treatment, their care, and their fair price (that was mostly covered by the insurance). I'll always be your advocate, thank you!!

I'll save you the post-op pictures and share our happy Phoebe from Halloween (a month after the incident!)
Great place to take your family pet good service kind people I would recommend

The doctor immediately recognized that our cat had urinary stones and available right away to take her into surgery. They kept her at the hospital for several days to recover after removing five very sharp stones. $1,500 for the entire thing, including follow-ups. Doctor saved her life.

I walked in, spoke to someone for a few minutes, and walked right back out. I could tell they were getting ready to go to lunch and didn't want to be bothered with whatever I was bringing in that could interrupt her lunch time. She tried very hard to tell me there was nothing they could do for me, in her "nicest" ( rudest) way possible.
The vet was very kind and professional. He treated my golden retriever's emergency. Today he is improving thanks to his care. I recommend him 👍 …

I have to change my review:
$$$$
Every visit costs $400 which is less than my orthopedic visit last month. …
Lovely people, long wait times.
This clinic saves my dogs life after she swallow a piece of a corn on the cob her name is Bamma the vet took her in soon as I walked in shout out to him

Please avoid this place at all costs. I visited this vet 4 years ago for a broken nail on my dog's paw and after getting put on anesthesia to remove the nail-plus recommending teeth surgery for hundreds of dollars (which had nothing to do …

really not quite good. very old, outdated office, equipment, and filing system to start. extremely cold and uncaring individuals working there by and large with very poor communication skills to pet parents about what is actually going on …

Highly Recommend Logan Square, Animal Hospital. I have been coming here for years often on and they are always very friendly and helpful. Gets me in and out no time flat. Prices are extremely reasonable.
